IIA.meaning: share of pairs whose patched legal decision lands in the target set

r0.meaning: share of pairs whose UNPATCHED base decision already lands in the target set

flip_rate.meaning: share of pairs whose legal decision changes at all under the patch

target_margin.meaning: change in the best target logit minus the mean change of the other legal actions

D(x).meaning: the network's decision on input x: legal argmax of the place head

network_own_target.meaning: D(s) for switch-on and switch-off, D(b) for specificity

IIA_net_star.meaning: (A - A0) / (1 - A0), A = P(D_R = D(s)), A0 = P(D(b) = D(s)); stored as iia_star in C2 arms

F.meaning: specificity flip rate P(D_R != D(b)) on pairs where C is false in both

E.meaning: excess leak: F minus the median F of the null

rho.meaning: relative leak E / IIA_net*(switch-on); undefined when that is <= 0; context-blind at >= 0.5

oracle_iia_star.meaning: Wave 1's primary score (target = the rational move), kept for continuity

ceiling.meaning: the full-activation patch (z_s into the base), under both targets

feasibility.rule: >= 50% of concepts powered in every arm (n_min {'switch_on': 100, 'specificity': 100, 'switch_off': 50})

gate.rule: R7 concept-consistent or (on-only) for >= 50% of powered concepts (Wave 1b pre-registration S10, per gold set)
